tools.name: list_journal_keys
tools.title: List journal keys
tools.description: List every stored key in the signed-in user's trading journal, with the size of each stored value.

tools.name: read_journal_value
tools.title: Read journal value
tools.description: Read one stored value from the signed-in user's trading journal by key (e.g. a trades list or settings entry). Use list_journal_keys first to discover keys.

key.description: Journal storage key, as returned by list_journal_keys.

tools.name: write_journal_value
tools.title: Write journal value
tools.description: Create or replace one stored value in the signed-in user's trading journal. The value must be the exact string the journal app expects (usually JSON). Overwrites any existing value for that key.

key.description: Journal storage key. Must start with the journal prefix 'tj_'.

value.description: Raw string value to store, typically JSON text.
